items.title: Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah
items.charge: Prophesying lies in the Lord's name to the captives; committing adultery with their neighbours' wives

items.title: Amaziah the priest of Bethel
items.charge: Forbidding Amos to prophesy at the king's chapel; accusing him to Jeroboam of conspiracy

items.title: Balaam
items.charge: Divination for hire; counseling Moab to seduce Israel into idolatry

items.title: Elymas the sorcerer
items.charge: Withstanding the apostles; seeking to turn the deputy from the faith

items.title: Hananiah the son of Azur
items.charge: Prophesying a lie in the name of the Lord

items.title: Jezebel of Thyatira
items.charge: Calling herself a prophetess; teaching the servants of God to commit fornication and eat things sacrificed to idols

items.title: Pashur the son of Immer
items.charge: Smiting the prophet and putting him in the stocks; prophesying lies

items.title: Shemaiah the Nehelamite
items.charge: Sending letters from Babylon to have Jeremiah put in prison and in the stocks; prophesying a lie

items.title: The man of God from Judah
items.charge: Turning back to eat and drink at Bethel against the word of the Lord

items.title: The prophets of Baal at Carmel
items.charge: Prophesying in the name of other gods

items.title: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah, and the four hundred prophets
items.charge: Prophesying victory at Ramoth-gilead by a lying spirit; smiting Micaiah on the cheek
